classification.difficultyReason: Choose multiplication or division from the target unit and combine successive metric factors for kilometre-to-centimetre and kilometre-to-millimetre conversions; no numerical evaluation is required.

content.prompt:
Convert these units of length. Only show the operation.
You do not need to find the answer.

answer.worked:

$$3.6\text{ km}=(3.6\times1000)\text{ m}$$

Divide by $10$ to convert millimetres to centimetres.
$$8.4\text{ mm}=(8.4\div10)\text{ cm}$$

Multiply by $100$ to convert metres to centimetres.
$$2.9\text{ m}=(2.9\times100)\text{ cm}$$

Divide by $1000$ to convert metres to kilometres.
$$7000\text{ m}=(7000\div1000)\text{ km}$$

Divide by $100$ to convert centimetres to metres.
$$594\text{ cm}=(594\div100)\text{ m}$$
